title: Governance Fixture Family Manifest
description: Canonical deterministic fixture for the governance-loop acceptance matrix. One fixture encodes the inputs and golden expected outcome for a single governance path on a fresh non-Amber target. The family is the set of all committed fixture files under tests/fixtures/governance/.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes to the fixture family.

fixtureId.description: Stable, kebab-case identifier for this fixture. Used as the acceptance-matrix row key.

path.description: Governance Console path this fixture exercises.

variant.description: canonical = the happy-path shape; adversarial = a deliberately hostile variant of the same path. Defaults to canonical when absent.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this fixture proves.

deploymentProfile.description: Deployment profile tracer this fixture targets. #160 requires the family to cover all three.

packageJson.description: The package.json written to the fresh target before amber init.

initialCommit.description: Whether the harness commits the seed files before init.

featureId.description: Feature id the fixture uses for plan/session. If omitted, the harness uses the seeded default.

gateId.description: The session gate the fixture approves. Defaults to user-approval-implement.

exitCode.description: Expected runner exit code for this fixture.

summary.description: Expected subset of the runner summary object. Fields present here must match the runner output exactly; fields absent are not asserted.

evidenceType.description: Stable identifier for the evidence class this fixture produces (e.g. timeline-event, approval-record, ingest-record).
